components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Call, retry, apply: the one filled action in a group.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:56px; padding:12px 18px; border-radius:16px; font:700 18px/1.45 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; color:#0b5d3b; background:#fff; border:2px solid #0b5d3b; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#0b5d3b; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#073f28; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffc20e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Directions, why this, read aloud: outlined white.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:56px; padding:12px 18px; border-radius:16px; font:700 18px/1.45 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; color:#0b5d3b; background:#fff; border:2px solid #0b5d3b; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#f3f6f4; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffc20e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Place search and other plain fields inside panels.
components.css: .ds-input { font:400 18px/1.45 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height:56px; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:14px; border:2px solid #d5dfd9; background:#fff; color:#13201a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#0b5d3b; outline:none; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: Ranking tag, registry mark, possible-match warning, ownership.
components.html: Fastest Registry listed Possible match Government
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font:700 14px/1.45 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:#f3f6f4; color:#13201a; border:1px solid #d5dfd9; } .ds-chip-reg { background:#e6f0fc; color:#08458f; border-color:#b8d3f3; } .ds-chip-tag { background:#0b5d3b; color:#fff; border-color:#0b5d3b; } .ds-chip-warn { background:#fff6d6; color:#4a3500; border-color:#ecc95a; }

components.name: Slip Panel
components.description: White sign panel with inset green keyline; holds all clinical content.
components.html:
District Hospital

“Emergency obstetric care available 24 hours.”
components.css: .ds-panel { position:relative; background:#fff; border-radius:18px; padding:22px 20px; color:#13201a; font:400 18px/1.45 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-panel::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:6px; border:2px solid #0b5d3b; border-radius:13px; opacity:.16; pointer-events:none; } .ds-panel > * { position:relative; } .ds-name { margin:12px 0 0; font-size:28px; line-height:1.12; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-quote { margin:12px 0 0; padding:12px 14px; background:#e6f0fc; border:1px solid #b8d3f3; border-radius:12px; font-size:17px; }

components.name: Road Bar
components.description: Signature: solid free-flow minutes, hatched yellow delay, bracketed likely range.
components.css: .ds-road { position:relative; height:14px; margin:26px 0 8px; background:#f3f6f4; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid #d5dfd9; } .ds-free { position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 0; width:45%; background:#0b5d3b; border-radius:7px 0 0 7px; } .ds-delay { position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; left:45%; width:25%; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#ffc20e 0 6px,#1c1500 6px 8px); } .ds-range { position:absolute; top:-6px; bottom:-6px; left:40%; width:40%; border:2px solid #13201a; border-top:0; border-bottom:0; border-radius:2px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff; }

components.name: Emergency Card
components.description: Replaces the slip when the red-flag gate fires; red ground, white call buttons.
components.html:
Call for help now

Call 108
components.css: .ds-emerg { background:#c8102e; color:#fff; border-radius:18px; padding:22px 20px; font:400 18px/1.45 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.55); } .ds-emerg h1 { margin:0; font-size:30px; line-height:1.1; } .ds-call { display:flex; align-items:center; margin-top:18px; background:#fff; color:#c8102e; text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:26px; border-radius:16px; padding:14px 18px; min-height:68px; }

narrative.overview: The interface borrows India's highway wayfinding boards: a deep green ground, white sign panels that carry the real information, and a small set of signal colors that each mean one thing. One answer, the referral slip, owns the screen. Clinical content sits on opaque white; Glisse glass (data-theme dark) appears only on the top strip and composer. Color carries meaning: yellow doubt, blue facility facts, red emergency only.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque white panels on a board-green ground, with a faint inset green keyline on each panel.
Glass is reserved for floating chrome; panel buttons are solid and outlined.
Single typeface family (Atkinson Hyperlegible) with system Indic fonts as the fallback chain; hierarchy by size and weight 700 only.
Large tabular numerals for distance and time.
The road bar is the one signature graphic.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every signal color has a single job (yellow doubt, blue fact, red emergency). A color is never borrowed for emphasis.

rules.name: The Red Is Reserved Rule
rules.body: Emergency red appears only in the emergency card and its call buttons.

rules.name: The Contrast On Board Rule
rules.body: Text placed directly on the green ground is white (or the pale green #d6efe3 for footers) and carries a faint text-shadow; clinical text never sits directly on green.

rules.name: The Script Safety Rule
rules.body: For hi, ta, te, ml, letter-spacing resets to 0 and line height rises. Negative tracking is Latin-only.

rules.name: The Weight Pair Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 700 exist. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not from additional fonts or weights.

rules.name: The Glass Is Chrome Rule
rules.body: Glass appears on the top strip, the composer and its mic only. Slips, quotes, cautions, panel buttons and sheets are opaque.

dos: Do keep clinical content on opaque Panel White and reserve Glisse glass (data-theme="dark") for the top strip, composer and mic.
Do use Signal Yellow only for doubt or delay, Facility Blue only for facts about a facility, and Emergency Red only for emergencies.
Do keep touch targets at 56px (44px minimum for text buttons and strip controls) and body text at 18px.
Do show the road bar, confidence meter and quoted evidence with source on any recommendation.
Do reset letter-spacing and raise line height for Indic scripts.
Do pair every signal color with an icon or words; color is never the only carrier.
donts: Don't put text directly on the green ground unless it is white with the board text-shadow.
Don't add decorative colors, extra typefaces or weights beyond 400 and 700.
Don't use glass for panels, buttons inside panels, or sheets.
Don't render government emblems or scheme logos.
Don't let the slip become one of many identical chat cards; one slip owns the screen and alternatives stay compact.
